# Cue Skill snapshot

[`skills/cue/SKILL.md`](skills/cue/SKILL.md) is a verified release snapshot of
the canonical [`cue` Skill](https://github.com/zendev-lab/cue/tree/main/skills/cue).
[`skills/cue.upstream.json`](skills/cue.upstream.json) records its source commit
and digest; `pnpm run check:cue-skill` enforces both. Do not edit the snapshot as
an independent Spark source.
